scope: Ki Blast Ultimate coverage expansion — current high-confidence records

records.name: Final Flash (SS3 DAIMA)
records.effect: Electrified Final Flash beam; holding the input above the initial Ki requirement spends remaining Ki to extend the beam and greatly boost power; 22–53 hits.

records.name: Super Kamehameha (SS4 DAIMA)
records.effect: Extended Super Kamehameha; holding the input on hit consumes an additional 100 Ki for a stronger cinematic blast; 12–33 hits.

records.name: Thunder Flash
records.effect: Protected charging stance followed by a long-range Ki beam; holding the input consumes up to 300 additional Ki to extend the attack and increase damage; 19 hits.

records.name: Prominence Flash
records.effect: Chargeable fiery Ki wave; 38 hits and over 50% damage, with damage increasing on each use through the third activation.

records.name: Mystic Flash
records.effect: Rear-only green Ki wave that deals 30% damage over 25 hits; cannot be fired forward.
